fields.bid_security: All bids must be accompanied by a "Bid Security "CPO or unconditional Guarantee issued by a Bank for Lot-1, 47,500 Birr Lot 2- 18,700.00 Birr/ and Lot 3- 18,500.00 Birr Totally for Lot 1,2 & 3 are = 84,700.00 /Eight four thousand seven hundred birr only/ from a reputable Bank prepared in the name of Asella City Administration Finance office.
fields.bidding_details: Bidding will be conducted through the National Competitive Bidding procedures as Specified in the World Bank's "Procurement Goods, Works and non-consulting service under IBRD Loans and IDA Credits & Grants by World Bank Borrowers"("Procurement Guideline"), and is open to all eligible bidders as defined in The Procurement Guidelines. Interested eligible bidders may obtain further information from Asella City Administration Finance office near Asella branch Ethiopian Electric utility Department of procurement and property administration and inspect the bidding documents during office hours from 8:30 AM- 5:30 PM (local time) at the address given below. A complete set of bidding documents in English may be purchased by interested eligible Bidders upon payment of a nonrefundable fee of 300.00 birr. The method of payment will be deposit in CBE Account No 1000022706261 Bids must be delivered to the address below on or before----------2022 at 2:00 PM (Local Time) and will be open the same day at 2:30PM (Local Time) on 30th calendar Days from Announcement of the Ethiopian Herald. Electronic bidding will not be permitted. Late bids will be rejected. Bids will be publicly opened in the presence of the bidders designated representatives and anyone who chooses to attend at the address below at the end of this invitation and also bidders should submit sealed bid documents containing one original and two copies.
fields.delivery_address: Asella City Administration Finance office 2nd floor No 19 Street: Near Ethiopian Electric utility Asella Branch Around Asella city Administration office
